title: Listing Highlight: 106' Falcon 106 2001 | Q
description: Explore the luxurious 2001 Falcon 106 M/Y Q, designed by Stefano Righini. This elegant yacht comfortably accommodates 10 guests in 5 staterooms.
html:
A Timeless Stefano Righini Design Offering Unparalleled Luxury and Space

The 2001 Falcon 106 M/Y Q stands as a testament to classic yacht design, offering a harmonious blend of refined elegance and practical luxury. Conceived by the renowned Stefano Righini, this motor yacht exudes a sophisticated charm that continues to captivate discerning enthusiasts. She is a vessel crafted for memorable experiences on the water, perfectly suited for both private enjoyment and exclusive charter ventures. From her sleek profile to her meticulously appointed interiors, M/Y Q promises an exceptional journey. The main salon provides an inviting atmosphere, adorned with plush furnishings and expansive windows that frame breathtaking panoramic views, creating an ideal setting for relaxation or formal gatherings. Adjacent to this social hub, a formal dining area offers an elegant space for exquisite meals, making every occasion onboard feel special.

Accommodation on the Falcon 106 M/Y Q is thoughtfully designed to ensure ultimate comfort and privacy for up to 10 guests across five luxurious staterooms. This generous layout includes a magnificent master suite, alongside well-appointed VIP and guest cabins, each featuring en-suite facilities and modern amenities. The crew quarters are also well-arranged, accommodating a dedicated team of up to five professionals to ensure impeccable service throughout any voyage. The exterior decks are equally impressive, providing a multitude of spaces for outdoor living and entertainment. The expansive flybridge, a particular highlight, features ample seating, a bar, and sunpads, making it the perfect spot for sunbathing, al fresco dining, or simply enjoying the open air. The aft deck offers a shaded area for casual dining and provides seamless access to the swim platform, inviting guests to enjoy water activities with ease.

Her robust construction and twin MTU 16V 2000 M90 engines ensure reliable and comfortable cruising, whether navigating coastal waters or embarking on longer journeys across the open sea.

Below deck, the attention to detail continues, with systems designed for efficient operation and optimal guest comfort. The galley is fully equipped to cater to gourmet culinary needs, supporting the exceptional dining experiences offered aboard. Every element, from the navigation electronics to the onboard entertainment systems, has been selected to enhance the yachting lifestyle. For those seeking a vessel that combines classic aesthetics with enduring quality and exceptional comfort, the 2001 Falcon 106 M/Y Q presents an outstanding opportunity. Her Stefano Righini design ensures a timeless appeal, while her spacious layouts and comprehensive amenities provide a versatile platform for grand adventures and intimate escapes alike.

This yacht represents a gateway to the finest maritime experiences, standing ready for her next chapter of luxurious voyages.
